title: Priority Support Sync — Cribsheet and After-Action Pad
content:
Purpose / TL;DR:
This is my quick cribsheet for the priority support sync with ACME (Tier 1 customer) — timeboxed 30m. Use for live note-taking, decisions, and immediate action items. Keep external comms short and empathetic; escalate internal fixes.

Meeting goals (ranked):
1) Confirm scope & user impact (who is blocked, what features down) — stamp with metrics.
2) Decide next 3 immediate mitigations (external-facing and internal).
3) Assign owners for mitigation + quick ETA.
4) Agree on a customer-facing update cadence (next update in 30m / 60m).
5) Capture clear post-mortem owners + timeline.

Pre-meeting checklist (what to gather before joining):
- Last 60m error spikes (Sentry / Datadog dashboard link) — have screenshot/one-line summary.
- Model versions in prod for affected routes (api logs) — need model sha/quantization profile.
- Recent deploys (last 6h) — PR ids and rolling window.
- Resource metrics: GPU memory pressure, queue latency, host OOMs.
- Customer-reported examples (request id(s) + timestamp) — get a redacted trace.
- Active runbook snippets relevant to timeout/retry behavior.
- Contact list: ACME CSM (Dana), ACME Eng lead (Ravi), Redwood AM/AE.

Attendees (pre-populated):
- Zoe Park (facilitator / notes)
- Marco Alvarez (SRE / telemetry)
- Priya Desai (Eng oncall / rollback owner)
- Lena Ivanov (CSM / customer comms)
- Optional: Release eng (if deploy-related)

Meeting timeline (30m):
- 0:00–2:00 Quick context and confirm attendees / goals
- 2:00–7:00 Customer impact summary + live evidence (Marco)
- 7:00–15:00 Rapid hypothesis & immediate mitigations (Priya + Marco)
- 15:00–22:00 Assign owners, set ETAs, and decide comm cadence
- 22:00–28:00 Draft customer update + approvals (Lena + Zoe)
- 28:00–30:00 Confirm next checkpoint & close

Live note area (fill during meeting):
- Reported start: 2024-10-02T08:12:34Z
- Symptoms: elevated 5xx for /v1/chat/completions, increased tail latency > 2s for short prompts
- Customer impact: multiple production hosts for ACME experiencing failed completions; primary product flow degraded (estimated 12% of requests failing for the account)
- Evidence links: Datadog dashboard screenshot id dt-2410, Sentry error id s-18902, request example ids rqx-998, rqx-1001
- Recent deploys: PR#4521 (model migration to v1.3-quant) rolled at 07:40 UTC; canary showed marginal increase in p95 but not flagged
- Hypotheses (quick list):
  * Hypothesis A: Regression introduced by quantized kernels (model runtime mismatch)
  * Hypothesis B: KV-cache corruption for long conversations after the migration
  * Hypothesis C: Burst of traffic saturated batching threshold causing queue timeout fallback

Immediate mitigations proposed (choose up to 3):
- Mitigation 1 (fast rollback): Revert PR#4521 on dedicated pool A (Priya) — ETA 20m to start, 40m to verify
- Mitigation 2 (routing): Route ACME traffic to legacy model variant (v1.2-fp16) for safety — ETA 10m to enact (Marco)
- Mitigation 3 (tune): Reduce batch window from 20ms -> 5ms for affected route to lower queue latency (Priya, Marco) — ETA 15m to config and verify

Owner assignments / action items (post-meeting will copy into Jira CSUP-4219):
- Priya Desai: Execute rollback plan for PR#4521 (if greenlit). Due: 2024-10-02T09:30Z
- Marco Alvarez: Apply routing rule to send ACME production traffic to v1.2-fp16 and monitor error rate (DM to SRE channel). Due: 2024-10-02T08:50Z
- Lena Ivanov: Draft customer-facing message template and confirm with AE (Dana). Due: 2024-10-02T08:45Z
- Zoe Park: Post internal summary to #priority-escalations with decision and next checkpoint. Due: 2024-10-02T08:55Z
- Marco + Priya: Collect diagnostic artifacts and attach to Jira (logs, core dumps, kernel traces). Due: 2024-10-02T12:00Z

Customer-facing update (short, empathetic template):
Hi Dana / ACME team —
Thanks for flagging this. We see degraded completions and have identified potential causes; we are applying a targeted mitigation now and will update you in 30 minutes with status and ETA for full recovery. Do you have a list of critical request IDs we should prioritize?

(Do not promise a rollback timeframe unless confirmed.)

Escalation decision criteria (when to go to exec-level):
- >30% error rate sustained for >30m for a top-3 customer
- Data loss or repeated wrong outputs flagged as PII exposure
- SLA breach risk within next 2 hours

Rollback & fallback checklist (quick):
- Confirm known-good model sha for fallback (zsha-1.2.34)
- Validate compatibility across host types (gpu/host config)
- Communicate to billing/AE if fallback affects throughput/cost
- Keep one engineer dedicated to monitoring rollback metrics

Post-meeting postmortem seeds (to capture after stable):
- Timeline: events / deploys / mitigations chronologically
- Root cause candidates and verification steps for each hypothesis
- Customer impact summary + estimated downtime / affected ops
- Remediation plan (short-term and long-term) + owners and due dates
- Learning: what to add to runbook to make response faster next time

Notes to self (Zoe):
- Remind Priya to include model-compile logs — they often reveal kernel mismatch
- Ask Marco for a one-liner on Datadog dashboard that the customer can see (helps CSM)
- Keep the update template under 3 bullets: impact, action taken, next update ETA
- Breathe. Keep the tone calm.

After-action quick capture (fill once incident stabilised):
- What mitigations worked: routing to v1.2-fp16 dropped error rate from 12% -> 1.3% in 12m
- What didn't: batch window tuning had marginal effect, rollback not executed (decision to route instead)
- Customer reaction: ACME acknowledged update and requested a post-mortem within 72h
- Short-term owners: Priya (engineering), Marco (SRE), Lena (CSM)
- Postmortem owner: Zoe (lead) — due draft by 2024-10-05

Unresolved / follow-ups (capture as Jira subtasks):
- Validate whether quantized kernels differ between v1.2 and v1.3 in memory layout (Eng research)
- Add automated smoke-check for each canary that runs a short prompt set (Quality)
- Update runbook: add explicit route fallback steps and who can enact them

Quick reference commands / links I might need in the meeting: (placeholders)
- Can route change command: infra route set --service acme --model v1.2-fp16 --confirm
- Rollback command: deploy revert --pr 4521 --pool A
- Datadog graph query id: DD_GRAPH_9982 (errors by service)

My quick finish checklist before closing meeting:
- Confirm owner for each action + due time in Jira
- Agree on next checkpoint time (30m min) and owner for update
- Write external update and get CSM signoff

Personal scratch / sign-off line: I will hop into SRE channel after this to confirm the routing change and watch for anomalies for 60 minutes. If things look unstable, call another 15-min sync.

---
History / context block (for reference):
- 2024-09-28: Initial rollout of v1.3-quant to staging; small perf wins but not full load tested
- 2024-10-01 23:50 UTC: Canary for PR#4521 started on pool B, no alert triggered

(End cribsheet)
